name: simrip
tagline: Plan itineraries, packing, bookings, and expenses without signing up
description:
simrip is an iPhone and iPad travel planning app for organizing domestic and international itineraries without signing up. Keep local dates, time zones, packing lists, booking notes, and expenses together for each trip.

Humation avatars appear in Edit together to identify the owner and other participants.

screenshots.alt: simrip home screen with sample itinerary and create trip actions
Sample trip itinerary arranged by day and time
Packing checklist with categories, completed items, and reorder controls
Trip expenses screen showing the sample total and one itinerary expense
Collaboration screen with Humation avatars and participant roles

ja.tagline: 登録なしで旅程・持ち物・予約・費用をひとまとめに
ja.description:
simrip は、会員登録なしで使える iPhone・iPad 向けの旅行計画アプリです。国内・海外を問わず、現地の日付とタイムゾーン、持ち物リスト、予約のメモ、費用を旅ごとにまとめて管理できます。

Humation アバターは「Edit together」で使われていて、旅のオーナーとほかの参加者を見分けるのに役立ちます。
ja.usage: Edit together に表示される参加者のアバター
